requirements.text: Backend role/object scope menolak route/ID tebakan pada ketiga role; actor berasal dari session. Session expired/tampered, CSRF/origin/rate limit, disable/revoke, invite/reset expiring dan single-use, bootstrap privat tanpa default/demo account teruji.

Allowlist ketiga role berlaku pada search/detail/history, validation error/status/recovery, receipt/report/print/PDF/CSV/media, cache dan logs. Staff tidak menerima acquisition cost/history/HPP/profit atau sensitive security/recovery details; original-result recovery yang berizin tetap tersedia. Incoming cost write-only tidak di-echo atau disimpan dalam browser recovery. Logout/actor change/Back/Forward/reload/bfcache tidak menampilkan finance/cache Pemilik kepada staff; history encryption/invalidation tidak membolehkan stored write-only cost.

Disable/reset/revoke, role/config/payment-method/profile/onboarding writer dan business command memakai matching ordered guards. Real PostgreSQL race membuktikan perubahan yang menang diterapkan pada validasi; request yang tidak lagi sah ditolak sebelum facts dan snapshot memakai revision yang benar. Command yang lebih dahulu commit tetap konsisten/audited. Recent authentication dan recovery reauthorization tetap berlaku.

Nama/SKU/kategori/brand dan exact manufacturer/internal barcode bekerja; leading zeros/case/punctuation dipertahankan, declared EAN/UPC check digit tervalidasi. SKU/barcode unik global di bawah concurrent create; retired token tidak direcycle.

Shared Product Search default 25/max 100 dengan stable name/ID order, context/active filter dan tanpa full-master fetch. Receiving memilih existing product; similar matches ditinjau sebelum create, exact collision hard reject, create product tetap stock 0; base unit/precision tidak dapat diubah setelah movement pertama, termasuk race edit/posting pertama.

Late/stale lookup tidak mengubah pilihan/draft secara keliru; hasil complete scan berurutan. Manual/IME, repeated code satu base unit, empty CR/LF/key-repeat, unknown token retained, disconnect/partial input dan focus/dialog/count guards teruji. Scan hanya draft; scanner Enter tidak posting/bayar/close; offline tidak mengantre mutation.

Setiap physical delta memiliki immutable movement/source/actor/server time/posting sequence; ledger sum = synchronous balance. Receipt/opening same/different-key retry posts once. Rekonsiliasi mismatch terdeteksi dan memblokir affected posting; repair berizin tanpa direct balance edit.

Manual issue wajib reason non-sale. Aggregate duplicate product lines sebelum stock check; last-unit concurrent issue/Sale tidak oversell. Failure injection pada setiap movement/balance/cost/audit/result boundary me-rollback seluruh command; qty/precision/range/overflow dan active/version guard teruji.

Owner reversal mempertahankan original, hanya satu full reversal eligible standalone source, exact inverse dan linked valuation. Duplicate/different-key/negative/unsafe replay ditolak; SALE_ISSUE/RETURN_RECEIPT tidak dapat direversal mandiri. Adjustment/revision append-only memakai reason/permission/recent auth.

Persistent onboarding flag memblokir ordinary inventory/Sale termasuk race. Maksimal 100 rows atomik, 101 ditolak, invalid row rollback seluruh command, sekali per produk/no prior ledger/disjoint commands. Zero count hanya checklist tanpa movement; qty/cost/UNKNOWN/reference review dan owner reconciliation sebelum flag dilepas; human count tanpa DB lock.

Tepat satu completed Sale/lines/full Payment/SALE_ISSUE/balance/cost atau UNKNOWN/ReceiptSnapshot/audit/durable result per source intent. Same/different-key duplicates dan failure injection setiap boundary tidak menciptakan partial payment/stock success; owner/cashier wajib own eligible OPEN session.

Total Rp75.000, tender Rp100.000 menghasilkan change Rp25.000 dan applied Rp75.000; insufficient cash ditolak. BANK_TRANSFER exact full total dengan optional reference dan human receipt confirmation, tanpa physical cash effect. Tidak ada split/partial payment, gateway verification atau cashier price override.

Definite rejection membolehkan review draft; UNCERTAIN membekukan original intent/key/payload tanpa replacement/charging ulang. Lost response/status/reload memulihkan original termasuk sesudah CLOSED; reauthorization tetap berlaku. Disabled method/price tampering/stale price ditolak; print failure/reprint tidak menduplikasi fakta.

Cumulative refund money dan return qty dibatasi terpisah di bawah race/locks; retained original Sale/Payment/receipt. Executed CASH/BANK_TRANSFER owner-funded payouts terpisah. Refund-only tidak menambah stock dan mempertahankan HPP; saleable return memulihkan original matched cost sekali, return setelah refund dibolehkan dalam bound, damaged/non-saleable tidak menambah usable stock.

Minimum 5: 6 NORMAL, 5/1 LOW, 0 OUT; minimum 0 tanpa interval LOW, active new product 0 adalah OUT. Audited threshold edit/receipt/inactive filter memperbarui current badge/list konsisten. Mutation/focus/interval ≤30 detik refresh; failed query menampilkan stale/error/last refresh, bukan empty/zero/Normal.

Contoh MWA di15 menghasilkan sales Rp60.000/HPP Rp36.000/Laba Kotor Rp24.000. Qty 0–3 desimal, six-place decimal cost, integer-IDR half-up sekali per line, aggregate/overflow, fractional/final-stock residual dan non-sale issue valuation benar; tidak memakai binary float/latest purchase price.

Blank/UNKNOWN berbeda dari evidenced zero. Unknown receipt membuat downstream valuation/HPP incomplete, known historical allocations tetap valid; saldo 0 lalu receipt KNOWN membuka pool KNOWN baru tanpa melengkapi periode lama. Owner evidence revision/replay append-only tidak menimpa sources; incomplete HPP/profit/margin tidak ditampilkan sebagai complete/zero.

Refund-only mempertahankan HPP; saleable return mengambil original issue cost sekali, UNKNOWN tetap incomplete. Deterministic bounded replay/concurrent posting dan failed publication menghasilkan all-or-nothing. Reports memakai consistent asOf/revision/completeness/unknown line count dan half-open Jakarta periods; corrections server posting date, tanpa backdating/net-profit claim.
Cashier menutup sesi lalu membuka sesi baru pada businessDate yang sama; immutable report keduanya berbeda. Returning same-day bukan reopen atau overwrite sesi lama.

Partial unique constraints mencegah overlapping OPEN per logical register dan per responsible cashier, termasuk concurrent open. Handover close A lalu open B; tidak ada simultaneous shared drawer/responsibility edit.

Setiap completed Sale, termasuk transfer-only, teratribusi sekali ke own active session/register/cashier yang benar. Tanpa eligible OPEN session ditolak sebelum payment/stock; opening explicit Rp0 sah dan blank ditolak; opening/scanning tidak membuat Sale.

Opening Rp20.000 + CASH Rp100.000 + BANK_TRANSFER Rp50.000 dan physical Rp118.000 menghasilkan expected Rp120.000/variance −Rp2.000. Opening/physical cash wajib nonnegative. Transfer/owner refund/opening/variance tidak menjadi sales/profit atau hidden cash adjustment.

Sale-vs-close memakai lock/activityVersion yang sama: Sale menang tercakup sekali dan meminta recount; close menang membuat Sale ditolak sebelum facts. Tidak ada successful Sale yang hilang, tidak ada human count lock atau persistent CLOSING; UNCERTAIN checkout diselesaikan sebelum close.

Duplicate/lost close termasuk key berbeda menghasilkan satu CLOSED/snapshot/result. Conflicting count tidak menimpa; stale activityVersion meminta hitung ulang dan tetap OPEN. Failure snapshot/audit/result rollback mempertahankan OPEN; original result tetap recoverable setelah CLOSED.

Closed snapshot/count/variance/cutoff/source IDs/identity/template tidak dapat ditulis ulang/reopen. Count mistake menerima linked owner review note; later refund/return/correction tetap fakta terhubung dan tidak mengubah laporan as-closed.

Print/PDF/CSV/reprint tidak membuat/mengubah Sale/Payment/StockMovement/session; export failure retry snapshot asli. CSV mengutip text dan menetralkan formula/control prefix, mempertahankan negative numeric variance/IDR/timezone/session context. Request audit terpisah; print dialog bukan bukti tinta.

Owner daily totals berasal sekali dari source Sale/payment/cost berdasarkan tiap businessDate, tanpa menambahkan session totals. Beberapa sesi/same-day handover tidak double count. Midnight session tetap satu report close-date/full-span atau active section; variance per snapshot terpisah dari revenue/profit.

Cashier tidak membaca/close/export sesi cashier lain; actor scope server berlaku di route/status/media/file. Operations tidak mempunyai session/POS report grant. Owner-assisted close memerlukan current permission/recent auth/physical count/reason dan mempertahankan responsible cashier asli.

Owner log memfilter Sale/payment/stock/product/price/user/config/session/correction menurut date/user/type/product/session/reference. Audit successful change berada dalam business transaction; original actor/history dipertahankan. Operations hanya safe stock history, cashier own Sale/session; unrestricted/security audit staff ditolak, tanpa secret/full private payload logs.

BusinessProfile runtime/codename terpisah; name/logo/contact/email opsional/header/footer/document identity/accent tervalidasi memakai immutable revision/current pointer. Private logo PNG/JPEG/WebP ≤5 MiB/16 megapixels dire-encode/metadata stripped; SVG/HTML/URL fetch ditolak. Perubahan profile/template/logo tidak mengubah original Sale/session reprint; retained assets/media reauthorization teruji.

Reviewed forward migration/expand→backfill→verify→contract dijalankan sekali pada populated isolated target dengan constraint/row-count/business reconciliation dan backup/restore readiness. Target guard dan runtime privilege menolak DROP/UPDATE/DELETE immutable facts; credential migration terpisah. Tidak ada production reset/seed/mass deletion/down-v tanpa exact destructive approval.

Real independent encrypted backup/isolated restore ke target baru memverifikasi DB/media/template manifest/checksum dan seluruh actor/register/session/Sale/lines/Payment/issue/receipt/ledger/balance/cost revisions/refund/return/source intent/CommandReceipt/audit. Original snapshot/asset dapat direproduksi; tiap CLOSED tepat satu report, active uniqueness/attribution benar; mismatch memblokir reopening.

Restore revoke sessions dan recovery epoch menolak stale browser posting. Possibly lost post-cutoff sales diperiksa dari cash/transfer/printed/physical evidence; missing restored result bukan bukti tidak pernah commit, tanpa blind replay/direct balance edit. Independent key/access tersedia; G4 menerima measured RPO/RTO dan data gap, bukan target asumsi.

Seluruh surface mengikuti approved DESIGN revision/native compositions, runtime identity dan role semantics. Loading/empty/error/denied/stale/UNKNOWN/disabled/focus/success dapat diverifikasi. Lima widths 375/440/768/1024/1440, zoom 200%, keyboard/focus/44px touch targets/reduced motion/kontras menurut DESIGN; tidak ada clipped actions atau menu capability Later yang seolah aktif.

USB HID dan Bluetooth HID nyata, manual/IME/repeated/CRLF/focus/dialog/count/disconnect/partial/unknown fallback bekerja. Actual manufacturer/internal labels scannable; actual label/receipt thermal/A4 printers/driver/media/reprint berfungsi tanpa duplicate facts. Catat device/OS/browser/revision dan physical proof; emulator/print dialog tidak mendapat FINAL PASS.
